point.name: Point
point.tip: Emit particles from a fixed point

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.tip: Emit particles from random positions within a rectangle

circle.name: Circle
circle.tip: Emit particles from random positions within a circle

edge.name: Screen Edge
edge.tip:
Emit particles from random positions on the screen edge
Emission position is related to the initial movement angle

particleLayer-area-x.label: X
particleLayer-area-x.tip: Horizontal position of the emission area center

particleLayer-area-y.label: Y
particleLayer-area-y.tip: Vertical position of the emission area center

particleLayer-count.label: Emission Count
particleLayer-count.tip: Total number of particles to emit. Set to 0 to have no limit on the number

particleLayer-delay.label: Initial Delay
particleLayer-delay.tip: Time before the first particle is emitted

particleLayer-interval.label: Interval
particleLayer-interval.tip: Time interval between emitting each particle

particleLayer-lifetime.label: Lifetime
particleLayer-lifetime.tip: Particle lifetime from creation to destruction

particleLayer-lifetimeDev.label: Lifetime Dev
particleLayer-lifetimeDev.tip:
Maximum deviation range for the lifetime
Actual lifetime is a random value
Min = Lifetime - Deviation
Max = Lifetime + Deviation

particleLayer-fadeout.label: Fadeout
particleLayer-fadeout.tip: Time for the particle to transition to complete transparency before destruction

particleLayer-anchor-x-0.tip:
$Anchor X
Horizontal offset distance of the anchor
0: Anchor is at the midpoint of the particle's horizontal direction
-1: Shifted left by one particle width
1: Shifted right by one particle width

particleLayer-anchor-x-1.tip:
$Deviation
Generates a random value for the parameter
Min = Standard value - Deviation
Max = Standard value + Deviation

particleLayer-anchor-y-0.tip:
$Anchor Y
Vertical offset distance of the anchor
0: Anchor is at the midpoint of the particle's vertical direction
-1: Shifted up by one particle height
1: Shifted down by one particle height

particleLayer-anchor-speedX-0.tip:
$Anchor Speed X
The rate of change of 'Anchor X' per second

particleLayer-anchor-speedY-0.tip:
$Anchor Speed Y
The rate of change of 'Anchor Y' per second

particleLayer-movement-angle-0.tip:
$Movement Angle
The angle of the particle's initial velocity

particleLayer-movement-speed-0.tip:
$Movement Speed
The magnitude of the particle's initial velocity

particleLayer-movement-accelAngle-0.tip:
$Acceleration Angle
The rate of change of 'Movement Angle' per second

particleLayer-movement-accel-0.tip:
$Acceleration
The rate of change of 'Movement Speed' per second

particleLayer-rotation-speed-0.tip:
$Rotation Speed
The rate of change of 'Rotation Angle' per second

particleLayer-rotation-accel-0.tip:
$Angular Acceleration
The rate of change of 'Rotation Speed' per second

particleLayer-hRotation-radius-0.tip:
$Radius
The amplitude of the particle's back-and-forth horizontal movement, used to simulate rotation around the Y-axis

particleLayer-hRotation-expansionSpeed-0.tip:
$Expansion Speed
The rate of change of 'Radius' per second

particleLayer-hRotation-expansionAccel-0.tip:
$Expansion Acceleration
The rate of change of 'Expansion Speed' per second

particleLayer-hRotation-angle-0.tip:
$Rotation Angle
The particle's initial angle of rotation around the Y-axis
0 degrees = right, clockwise rotation

particleLayer-hRotation-angularSpeed-0.tip:
$Rotation Speed
The rate of change of 'Rotation Angle' per second

particleLayer-hRotation-angularAccel-0.tip:
$Angular Acceleration
The rate of change of 'Rotation Speed' per second

particleLayer-scale-factor-0.tip:
$Scale Factor
The scaling factor for particle size, 1 = 100%

particleLayer-scale-speed-0.tip:
$Scaling Speed
The rate of change of 'Scale Factor' per second

particleLayer-scale-accel-0.tip:
$Scaling Acceleration
The rate of change of 'Scaling Speed' per second

particleLayer-blend.label: Blend
particleLayer-blend.tip: Select a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

particleLayer-light.label: Light
particleLayer-light.tip: Affects the rendering of the image

global.name: Global Sampling
global.tip: Samples lighting from multiple pixel positions in the image to combine colors

ambient.name: Ambient Light
ambient.tip: Uses the current scene's ambient light to combine colors

particleLayer-sort.label: Sort
particleLayer-sort.tip: Select the particle sorting mode for this layer

youngest-in-front.name: Youngest in Front
youngest-in-front.tip: New particles are displayed in front of old particles

oldest-in-front.name: Oldest in Front
oldest-in-front.tip: Old particles are displayed in front of new particles

by-scale-factor.name: By Scale Factor
by-scale-factor.tip: Particles with a larger scale factor are displayed in front

particleLayer-sprite-mode.label: Sprite Mode
particleLayer-sprite-mode.tip: Select the display mode of the sprite

random.name: Random
random.tip: Randomly select a sprite from the divided sprite sheet to display

animation.name: Animation
animation.tip: Play the sprite sheet in order, selecting from left to right and wrapping to the next row

animation-loop.name: Animation(Loop)
animation-loop.tip: Play the sprite sheet in order and restart from the beginning after finishing

particleLayer-sprite-hframes.label: Horiz Frames
particleLayer-sprite-hframes.tip: Divide the particle sprite sheet into equal horizontal sections

particleLayer-sprite-vframes.label: Vert Frames
particleLayer-sprite-vframes.tip: Divide the particle sprite sheet into equal vertical sections

particleLayer-sprite-interval.label: Animation Interval
particleLayer-sprite-interval.tip: Duration each animation frame sprite stays on screen

particleLayer-color-mode.label: Color Mode
particleLayer-color-mode.tip: Choose a mode to fill the particle color

random.name: Random
random.tip: Specify a color range, randomly generate a color

easing.name: Easing
easing.tip: Specify a transition curve, with an initial color range and an ending color range, and compute interpolated colors continuously

texture.name: Texture Sampling
texture.tip: Use pixel colors from the particle sprite

particleLayer-color-easingId.label: Color Easing
particleLayer-color-easingId.tip: Used to calculate the interpolation color

particleLayer-color-tint-3-box.label: Tint - Grayscale
particleLayer-color-tint-3-box.tip: Grayscale is the opposite of saturation; higher grayscale means lower saturation
